text:
maria: Quick thread — thinking about saved-views model: should we make saved views atomic to a single route OR allow them to compose multiple model lenses? goal is simple UX for product teams + predictable telemetry and cost previews.

sam: Can you clarify "atomic" — you mean 1 saved view = 1 route + pinned model?

maria: yeah. atomic = route-scoped single-model pin. compose = saved view contains an ordered list of model pins + filters per-model.

kevin: From infra side, compose adds complexity: telemetry attribution becomes per-saved-object+model. still doable, but sampling and per-token cost previews need to look at the composition.

jess: Ownership/ACL nuance: teams expect to share a "view" across routes sometimes. If a view contains multiple models that don't exist on another route, we should surface graceful degradation.

sam: Concern: how do we handle rollouts? If model A is canaried on prod but saved view references A+fallback B, what does cost preview show?

kevin: We'd show both: expected steering matrix. But we'd need to simulate fallback token counts. UX might be overwhelming.

maria: proposal: saved view object has 2 modes: "single" (atomic) and "composite". default to single. composite is opt-in.

jess: +1 on default single. Composite only for advanced users. Also we should keep export/import stable so teams can copy between tenants.

sam: Also telemetry: saved view should carry sampling and metric bindings so when a view is applied, telemetry tagging includes saved_view_id + model_pin_id. That way we can attribute regressions.

kevin: Agreed. Implementation sketch (api shape):
```json
{
  "id": "sv_123",
  "scope": "route:orders:create",
  "mode": "composite",
  "model_pins": [
    {"model_id": "redwood/gpt-2-quant", "weight": 0.7},
    {"model_id": "redwood/gpt-2-fallback", "weight": 0.3}
  ],
  "filters": {"top_k": 5},
  "telemetry": {"sample_rate": 0.02, "tag": "campaign_x"}
}
```

maria: Nice. For single-mode simple shape. We should also store a minimal compatibility list for routes: which routes support which model archs. If a composite view is applied to incompatible route, show "partial apply" with warning.

jess: UX: in Console, when saving, default radio: [x] Save for this route only (recommended)  [ ] Save as multi-model lens. Show cost preview under both.

sam: Cost preview: we must show token-estimated cost for each pinned model AND an expected blended cost based on routing policy. That requires us to run quick sim on recent traffic distribution (or use default distribution weights).

kevin: Implementation detail: we can reuse batching/caching sim infra. We already sample requests for quota/cost previews. Need to extend sim to accept composite routing table.

maria: Telemetry gating: saved-view rollouts need canary knobs. plan: saved-view rollout API that accepts rollout_pct and fallback_view_id. That lets teams ramp composite views.

sam: Will need audit logs and a console timeline entry for when saved-views change routing. ops wants this for postmortems.

jess: On sharing: we need ACL model: owner/org/team + optional read-only share link. Also keep a migration path when underlying model versions change.

kevin: One more thing: we should snapshot model performance at save time (latency/cost/qual) so cost-preview uses stable baseline until you refresh. Otherwise saved-views change under your feet.

maria: Good point. Snapshot + last-refreshed timestamp. console shows stale badge.

console-bot: Note: added sample capture flag for saved-views in staging for testing (:white_check_mark:)

sam: Action items: 1) API proto from kevin (due EOD tomorrow) 2) Console mock for save modal (jess + maria) 3) Telemetry tagging change (sam + infra)

kevin: I'll throw a proto PR with the JSON shape above and a migration plan for existing saved queries.

jess: I'll wire a quick mock — will include "partial apply" state and cost-preview UI.

maria: thanks team. One more: we should document how composite views affect quotas and dedicated capacity accounting (e.g., if view pins models across Dedicated pools). cc @kevin

kevin: noted, will add capacity rules.

maria: ok closing — we'll sync in next weekly product sync with a short demo. :sparkles:

sam: 👍

jess: :thumbsup:

kevin: ✅
